description: The operations that change a sound's samples, as data: Reverse, Repeat, Add silence, Normalize, Pan, Dither, Filter, Stretch, Pitch, Speed and Repair, with an audio editor's Delete, Crop, Paste and Gain; applySoundOperation runs one on plain channels, on all of them or a stretch spliced back with crossfaded seams, soundOperationName names it as a step of the history
name: sound-operations
